ValidationRule.description: This validates that HCM Sales Consultants can only edit opportunities with WX products
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(TEXT( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c ) <> "WX", $UserRole.DeveloperName ="HCM_Sales_Consultant", NOT(OR($Profile.Name = "System Administrator" , $Profile.Name = "Data Migration", $Profile.Name = "Sales Administrator")),NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.OpportunityTrigger__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: HCM Sales Consultants can modify only WX Opportunities.
